integrity: The mathematical result has been checked against its stated premises and tested by finite computations. Computations are not an all-dimensional proof. No independent validation or publication-priority certification has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Standard ambient Euclidean metric; integer positive parameters and dimension at least two; proof uses the known complete facet theorem; near equality boundaries exact radicals are necessary. A wider published symmetric-polymatroid inball theorem may imply part of the formula.
title: Every facet cardinality occurs in the Euclidean inball of a generalized parking-function polytope
